title: AI LinkedIn posting agent with research and generated images
metaTitle: AI LinkedIn posting agent in n8n | Pixel2Tech
metaDescription: An n8n agent that researches a topic from Google Sheets, writes a LinkedIn post, creates an image with FLUX and publishes it, then logs the result.
summary: An n8n workflow that turns a topic in a spreadsheet into a researched LinkedIn post with its own AI-generated image, published and logged without manual copy and paste.
overview: We built this workflow for a client who wanted a steady LinkedIn presence without writing and designing every post by hand. Topics live in a Google Sheet. The workflow picks up a row, researches the subject on the web, writes the post, generates a matching image with a FLUX model on Hugging Face, publishes to LinkedIn and marks the row as done.
challenge: Posting on LinkedIn every week takes more time than it looks: someone has to research the topic, write copy that sounds informed, find or design an image and then publish it. When the team gets busy, the posting schedule is the first thing to slip.
approach: The run starts by reading the next topic row from Google Sheets. A research agent on Google Gemini calls the Tavily search API through an HTTP tool, gathers current information and drafts the post. A second Gemini agent turns the post into an image prompt. An HTTP request sends that prompt to a FLUX model on Hugging Face, and the returned Base64 data is converted into an image file. The LinkedIn node publishes the post with the image, a short code step tidies the result, and the workflow writes the status back to the sheet.
outcome: The client now adds topics to a sheet and gets finished LinkedIn posts with original images, published from one workflow. The sheet doubles as a content calendar and a record of what has gone out.

process.title: Map the content flow
process.body: We agreed how topics are queued in the sheet and what a finished post should include.

process.title: Build the research agent
process.body: We connected Gemini to Tavily search so each post draws on current information rather than model memory alone.

process.title: Add image generation
process.body: A second agent writes an image prompt, and the FLUX model on Hugging Face renders it into a file LinkedIn accepts.

process.title: Publish and log
process.body: We wired the LinkedIn post step and the sheet update, then tested runs end to end.

whyItMatters: Consistent posting is what makes LinkedIn work for a business, and this workflow keeps the posts coming even when nobody has time to write them.

faqs.q: Can I review posts before they go live?
faqs.a: Yes. We can add an approval step, for example a status column in the sheet or a Slack message, so a post is only published once someone signs off.

faqs.q: Can you build something similar for my business?
faqs.a: Yes. We adapt the workflow to your tools and process, including your preferred AI model and image style, and give you a fixed quote after a short call.
